license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to profess to be a podiatrist or chiropodist or to practice or assume the duties incident to podiatry or chiropody without first obtaining from the State Board of Podiatry Examiners a podiatry license.

issuing_authority.quote: obtaining from the State Board of Podiatry Examiners a podiatry license

degree_required.value: diploma or certificate of graduation from a recognized college of podiatric medicine accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education
degree_required.quote: received a diploma or certificate of graduation from a recognized college of podiatric medicine which has been accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

required.quote: an applicant for licensure must have completed a one-year post-podiatric medical formal preceptorship or residency program approved by the American Association of Podiatric Physicians and Surgeons or the American Podiatric Medical Association

duration.quote: completed a one-year post-podiatric medical formal preceptorship or residency program

kind.value: post-podiatric medical formal preceptorship or residency program
kind.quote: one-year post-podiatric medical formal preceptorship or residency program approved by the American Association of Podiatric Physicians and Surgeons or the American Podiatric Medical Association

exams.name: National Board of Podiatry Examination
exams.notes: Board may also use other written or oral examinations; any written exam must be nationally recognized or administered by at least one other state.
exams.quote: the board shall use the National Board of Podiatry Examination and may use other written or oral or written and oral examinations as the board considers necessary

interval_years.quote: A person licensed to practice podiatry must pay a biennial renewal license fee

required.quote: biennially must complete twenty-four hours of continuing medical education through a program approved by the South Carolina Board of Podiatry Examiners

hours_per_period.quote: biennially must complete twenty-four hours of continuing medical education

period_years.quote: biennially must complete twenty-four hours of continuing medical education

value: 2 hours related to approved procedures of prescribing and monitoring controlled substances listed in Schedules II, III, and IV (if authorized to prescribe controlled substances)
topical_requirements.quote: two of the requisite biennial hours of continuing education must be related to approved procedures of prescribing and monitoring controlled substances listed in Schedules II, III, and IV

available.quote: a license may be issued to a podiatrist or a chiropodist moving to this State from a state maintaining requirements for the practice of podiatry or chiropody equal to the standard in this State and extending the same reciprocal privileges

requirements.value: Applicant must come from a state with requirements equal to South Carolina's standards and that extends the same reciprocal privileges to SC podiatrists; payment of a fee required.
requirements.quote: a license may be issued to a podiatrist or a chiropodist moving to this State from a state maintaining requirements for the practice of podiatry or chiropody equal to the standard in this State and extending the same reciprocal privileges to podiatrists or chiropodists in this State

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, surgical, medical, and mechanical treatment of all conditions of the human foot and ankle. The practice of podiatry includes the administration of local anesthesia, defined as localized infiltration only, and in conjunction with the practice of podiatry. Excluded from the definition of podiatry is the amputation of the entire foot and the administration of an anesthetic other than local.
definition_quote.quote: the diagnosis, surgical, medical, and mechanical treatment of all conditions of the human foot and ankle. The practice of podiatry includes the administration of local anesthesia, defined as localized infiltration only, and in conjunction with the practice of podiatry. Excluded from the definition of podiatry is the amputation of the entire foot and the administration of an anesthetic other than local.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis, surgical, medical, and mechanical treatment of all conditions of the human foot and ankle

drug_authority.value: Administration and prescription of drugs incidental to the ankle; administration of local anesthesia (localized infiltration only)
drug_authority.quote: the administration and prescription of drugs incidental to the ankle, and the surgical treatment of manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear on the ankle

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the portions of skin, subcutaneous tissue, fascia, muscles, tendons and nerves at or below the level of the myotendinous junction of the triceps surae

amputation_authorized.quote: Excluded from the definition of podiatry is the amputation of the entire foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: The practice of podiatry includes the administration of local anesthesia, defined as localized infiltration only, and in conjunction with the practice of podiatry. Excluded from the definition of podiatry is the amputation of the entire foot and the administration of an anesthetic other than local.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: For podiatrists who are RRA qualified or certified, the diagnosis, surgical, medical, and mechanical treatment of all conditions of the human foot and ankle.

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: must have graduated from a three-year residency program in podiatric medicine and reconstructive rear foot and ankle (RRA) surgery accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: Surgery of the ankle and soft tissue structures governing the ankle must be performed in an accredited hospital or ambulatory surgical center.

systemic_disease_treatment_excluded.quote: except the medical treatment of any systemic disease causing manifestations in the foot or ankle

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: the surgical treatment of manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear on the ankle

value: American Board of Foot and Ankle Surgery
board_certification_body.quote: must be board-certified or board-qualified by the American Board of Foot and Ankle Surgery

controlled_substances_prescribing_ce_req.quote: two of the requisite biennial hours of continuing education must be related to approved procedures of prescribing and monitoring controlled substances listed in Schedules II, III, and IV

hospital_privileges_nondiscrimination.quote: medical staff governing documents shall include and provide for the right to pursue and practice full clinical and surgical privileges for holders of a Doctor of Podiatric Medicine (DPM) degree within the scope of his licensure. These rights and privileges only may be limited or restricted on the basis of the demonstrated competence of an individual practitioner.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: No part of this chapter shall be deemed to prohibit the fitting or sale of shoes or arch supports, excepting those shoes or arch supports or other mechanical devices or prosthetics that involve foot casting or impressions or fabricating for the feet

nondiscrimination_in_public_programs.quote: No agency of the State, county or municipality, nor any commission or clinic, nor any board administering relief, social security, health insurance or health service under the laws of the State of South Carolina shall deny to the recipients or beneficiaries of their aid or services the freedom to choose the provider of care or service which are within the scope of practice of a duly licensed podiatrist
